experiment: regression-weight leave-one-season-out CV (the gate on lowering 0.35)
prereg_rule: SHIP-LOWER iff every fold's CV weight <= 0.2 AND it beats-or-ties shipped out-of-sample on every fold; recommend the best mean-held-out weight. Accuracy gate only — $ arm still required.

verdict.text: SHIP-LOWER SUPPORTED (accuracy + overfitting gate PASSED). Leave-one-season-out picked a weight <= 0.2 on every fold ([0.1, 0.1, 0.0]), and it beat-or-tied the shipped 0.35 out-of-sample on all 3 folds (margins [0.065, 0.13, 0.0]). Most robust single value = 0.1 (mean held-out top-decile 0.5363, worst fold 0.478) vs shipped 0.35's ~0.41. RECOMMEND lowering 0.35 -> 0.1. STILL GATED on the dollar arm (roster grader, egress) before the numeric install.

caveat: 3 seasons, ~172-458 picks/season; top-decile is coarse at this n. rank_corr corroborates (0.0 best every season). Reads exp35's per-season curves; no egress. Installs nothing — updates DECISIONS-NEEDED #2 from OPEN to accuracy-gate-cleared.
